features.notes: Implemented on master baseline (not on feat/gate-rgm-on-reidentify, which it supersedes). 2026-06-18 pivot: skip is now NO-EXPIRY (skip if backfilled_at IS NOT NULL, any age) because reconnect-storm speed is the priority — a jittered staleness skip gave no relief for the storm-after-long-uptime case it most needs to help. Drift is bounded by the reconciliation delete on real backfills + cold re-backfills on UNLOGGED cache reset; it only accrues during disconnect windows, so good uptime keeps it small. A Phase 3b background sweep is DEFERRED/OPTIONAL (build only if roster staleness becomes a real complaint), not required. 2026-06-18 force-identify control: RestartShardRequest.force_identify signals the shard (atomic flag) and cancels it; the next Open clears+persists the resume tuple on the read-loop goroutine (rewritten in commit 58195f2 from the original racy in-gRPC-goroutine clear), avoiding DB-delete/pod-shutdown races and a 64-shard pod restart. Status flipped to 'passing' 2026-06-18 after staging validation ran (agent-progress.md Session 002d): no-RGM-storm small-guild reconcile, large-guild auto-RGM + multi-chunk decode, and the skip gate were all confirmed on staging. Apply guild_backfills (init.sql, IF NOT EXISTS) to the state DB before deploy; after prod deploy, seed the baseline via one full re-IDENTIFY.

features.title: Fall back to the main gateway URL when a stale resume_gateway_url is unreachable
features.user_visible_behavior: A shard whose persisted resume_gateway_url points at a Discord edge that no longer serves it (503 on the WebSocket handshake, before IDENTIFY) discards the resume tuple after 3 consecutive dial-stage failures and reconnects via wss://gateway.discord.gg/, instead of redialing the dead host once per second forever. The cleared tuple is persisted, so a pod restart cannot reload the dead host. The reconnect loop backs off exponentially (1s -> 60s, jittered) instead of retrying flat 1s.

2026-09-01: codex review --base master raised 1 P2 (confirmed): the backoff made RestartShard/gwForceIdentify a no-op for up to ~75s, since Open clears Session.cur on return and Cancel only reaches a live connection. Fixed with a per-shard depth-1 wake channel on the Manager (wakeShard, signalled by RestartShard); sleepCtx became waitBeforeReconnect(ctx, wake, d) (ok, woken) and a woken wait resets the failure ladder. 5 manager tests written first and watched fail; full suite re-run green (build, vet, go test ./..., -race -count=2).
features.notes: TATSU-2514 (prod incident 2026-09-01: 41/1024 shards stuck, zero self-healing, pods stayed 1/1 Running). Only DIAL-stage failures against the resume URL are counted - failures against the main gateway URL have no resume state to blame, and a cancelled connection context (shutdown / Cancel / ForceIdentify) is our own teardown and is not counted. The invalidation reuses the exact mechanism ForceIdentify already proved in production; this PR only gives it an automatic trigger. Recovery costs a full re-IDENTIFY and shard re-backfill (~1,400 guilds), which is why the threshold is 3 and not 1. NOT DONE in this PR (ticket bullet 4, explicitly 'Consider'): a metric/alert on 'shard has not reached ready in N minutes' - this outage class is still invisible to monitoring. Backoff must stay interruptible: Open clears Session.cur on return, so Session.Cancel cannot reach a shard that is between attempts — the Manager's per-shard wake channel is what keeps RestartShard/gwForceIdentify prompt.
